fact.detail: Congress enacted the Ak-Chin Indian Water Rights Settlement Act in 1978, amended 1984, 1992, 2000 (Pub. L. No. 95-328, Pub. L. No. 98-530, Pub. L. No. 102-497, Pub. L. No. 106-285), settling the water rights of Ak-Chin Indian Community of Papago Indians of the Maricopa. It quantifies 85,000 acre-feet a year in all and authorizes about $101.1 million in federal funds, as the Congressional Research Service counts it (R44148, Table 1).
